_comment: Synthetic support tickets for P03. No real customer, product, person or incident appears here; every ticket, name and identifier is invented for this curriculum.

tickets.subject: Charged twice for the September plan
tickets.body: My card shows two charges dated the same morning, both for the monthly plan. I have not changed anything on the account. Can one of them be reversed?

tickets.subject: Cannot sign in after the phone was replaced
tickets.body: I moved to a new handset and the sign-in code goes to the old one, which is wiped. There is no other way in that I can see. This is blocking my whole team.

tickets.subject: Label printer prints blank stickers
tickets.body: The desk printer feeds the roll and cuts it but nothing is printed. Ribbon is new. It worked on Friday.

tickets.subject: How do I export last quarter's invoices?
tickets.body: I need every invoice from July to September as one file for the accountant. I can only find them one at a time.

tickets.subject: Whole floor locked out since the maintenance window
tickets.body: Nobody on the second floor can sign in. It started after the overnight maintenance window. Fourteen people are sitting doing nothing.

tickets.subject: Refund never arrived
tickets.body: A refund was agreed three weeks ago and nothing has landed. I was told five working days.

tickets.subject: Duplicate charge on the August plan
tickets.body: Two identical charges on the same day for the monthly plan.
tickets.reply: One of the two charges was a duplicate authorisation and has been reversed. It clears back to the card within five working days.

tickets.subject: Sign-in code going to a lost phone
tickets.body: Handset replaced, codes still going to the old number.
tickets.reply: The sign-in factor has been reset to the address on file. Set up the new handset from the security page before the temporary factor expires.

tickets.subject: Printer feeds paper but prints nothing
tickets.reply: A ribbon fitted the wrong way round feeds and cuts normally and prints nothing. Refit it with the dull side facing the label.

tickets.subject: Bulk download of invoices
tickets.body: Wanted every invoice for a quarter in one file.
tickets.reply: Billing history has a date range and an export button; pick the quarter and choose the combined file.

tickets.subject: Site-wide lockout after a maintenance window
tickets.body: Nobody at one location could sign in after overnight work.
tickets.reply: A stale directory sync left one location's accounts unmatched. The sync was re-run and access returned within the hour.
